title: Beroxity Music — v0.4.220 Alpha
summary: Major update introducing an immersive full-window Now Playing experience, real-time audio visualizer, advanced queue management, drag-and-drop song ordering, and persistent recently played history. Includes a redesigned playback interface, improved responsive layouts, smarter shuffle and queue behaviour, extensive bug fixes, and further performance optimisations while preserving discord rich presence and stream dock integration.

sections.title: 🎶 Upcoming Queue & Listening History
items: Introduced a dedicated Upcoming queue displaying current and upcoming tracks.
Added manual queue management with priority over automatically queued songs.
Introduced persistent Recently Played history, including played and skipped tracks.
Added Add to Queue, Play Next, and Remove from Upcoming actions.
Added the ability to clear listening history.
Manual queue additions and listening history now persist between app restarts.
Improved queue ordering, track labels, and queue counters.

sections.title: 🖱️ Drag & Drop Queue Management
items: Added drag-and-drop support for songs from Library, Search, and Playlists.
Enabled direct rearranging of tracks within the Upcoming queue.
Added support for repositioning automatically queued tracks.
Introduced visual drop-position indicators and clearer drag highlighting.
Play Next now prioritises selected tracks at the front of Upcoming.
Add to Queue places tracks after manually queued songs but before automatic tracks.
Removed unnecessary queue movement arrows and the Clear Added button.
Disabled dragging in Recently Played and simplified the Upcoming layout.

sections.title: 🎧 Immersive Now Playing Experience
items: Introduced a full-window Now Playing experience.
Added large, responsive album artwork with a dynamic blurred background.
Displays the current song title, artist, album, and personal listening count.
Integrated playback, shuffle, repeat, seeking, volume, and favourite controls.
Added a Back to Music button, close button, and escape key support.
Music continues playing when switching between the main application and expanded player.

sections.title: 📋 Now Playing Queue Drawer
items: Introduced a sliding queue drawer within the expanded player.
Access Upcoming and Recently Played without leaving Now Playing.
Open and close the queue independently of playback.
Added separate queue visibility preferences for normal and expanded player modes.
Queue drawer dynamically resizes the Now Playing layout.
Improved full-height scrolling, panel sizing, and queue animations.

sections.title: 🌌 Live Audio Visualizer
items: Introduced a real-time audio-reactive visualizer.
Added animated purple frequency bars that respond to music and bass frequencies.
Visualizer movement dynamically responds to audio volume and frequency activity.
Added atmospheric purple lighting and smooth background transitions.
Introduced a Settings toggle to enable or disable the visualizer.
Visualizer preferences are saved between sessions.
Improved bass detection, animation smoothness, and frequency responsiveness.

sections.title: 🎨 Playback Controls & Visual Design
items: Redesigned playback buttons with individual dark-purple control backgrounds.
Introduced subtle purple hover effects and a unified progress bar panel.
Moved Favourite alongside Shuffle and Queue alongside Repeat.
Combined mute and volume controls into a cleaner interface.
Improved the volume slider with a hover-only thumb and removed the percentage label.
Improved album artwork sizing, alignment, and overall player consistency.
Introduced consistent thin purple scrollbars throughout the application.

sections.title: 📐 Responsive Layout & Navigation
items: Improved application resizing across different window dimensions.
Introduced minimum window dimensions to prevent layout issues.
Added a responsive icon-only sidebar with smoother animations.
Added fading navigation labels during sidebar transitions.
Improved the expanded Now Playing split-screen layout.
Optimised queue drawer height, scrolling, and responsive resizing.
Preserved queue navigation state when switching between views.
Expanded Library and Storage settings and improved Settings alignment.

sections.title: 🔀 Playback & Volume Fixes
items: Fixed Shuffle not correctly rearranging the Upcoming queue.
Corrected mismatches between displayed and actual shuffled playback order.
Improved mute and unmute behaviour.
Previous volume level is now restored when unmuting.
Fixed incorrect volume slider fill and alignment.
Maintained uninterrupted playback when switching application views.

sections.title: 🛠️ Now Playing & Interface Fixes
items: Fixed the queue drawer overlapping song information and playback controls.
Fixed queue visibility resetting when switching player modes.
Corrected unwanted layout changes when toggling the queue.
Removed the duplicate bottom playback bar from expanded Now Playing.
Prevented interaction with background application elements while expanded.
Removed visible application edges and unwanted scrolling in expanded mode.
Improved keyboard navigation and player layout stability.

sections.title: 💿 Library & Queue Bug Fixes
items: Fixed misaligned columns in music track lists.
Corrected overlapping duration labels and action buttons.
Improved row alignment across Library, Search, and Playlists.
Fixed dragged songs not appearing in the queue.
Corrected Add to Queue placement and inconsistent drag ordering.
Fixed hidden and duplicate queue entries.
Prevented deleted songs from reappearing in Upcoming.
Fixed incorrect queue counts, misleading labels, and songs being re-added unexpectedly.
Corrected virtualised queue scrolling issues.

sections.title: ⚡ Performance & Quality Improvements
items: Preserved virtualised music library and queue rendering.
Retained previous memory optimisations and lazy audio loading.
Improved scrolling responsiveness in large music queues.
Improved navigation and browsing performance with large libraries.
Optimised visualizer animation efficiency.
Refined queue drawer animations and sidebar transitions.
Improved overall interface consistency, scrolling, and track-list alignment.

sections.title: 🔗 Compatibility & Existing Features
items: Preserved existing music libraries, playlists, and song metadata.
Maintained shuffle, repeat, track skipping, and volume controls.
Retained playback resume positions and listening statistics.
Preserved Discord Rich Presence functionality.
Maintained Stream Dock hardware integration.
Ensured existing playback and library features remain available alongside the new interface.
